gap_bootstrap: patient resampling within sex-by-age and outcome strata
fairness_null: patient-level subgroup-label permutation within max-image-outcome strata; patient score is max calibrated image probability; exact patient event and non-event support is preserved within every sex-by-age group
demographic_coordinates: source-training image-standardised shared coordinates for C selection, source/target readouts, direction comparison, and intervention
residualization: orthogonal projection away from source-trained linear demographic-probe coefficient directions in source-standardised embedding space
privacy: aggregate outputs only; no identifiers, embeddings, models, or row-level predictions
